camera-shutter.description: Mechanical camera shutter click — crisp snapshot sound effect with mirror up and curtain return.
camera-shutter.recommended_use: Use when freezing frames, taking screenshots, capturing a profile or image card, or presenting visual evidence.

chime.description: Soft melodic chime — gentle positive beat: success/confirmation or a lighthearted transition. Sync to the visual moment.
chime.recommended_use: Sync to milestone completion, positive confirmation toasts, or gentle transition out of a successful workflow.

click-soft.description: Quiet short click — low-key UI tap / soft selection. Short accent, sync exactly to the on-screen action.
click-soft.recommended_use: Sync exactly to on-screen user actions like hovering, secondary selections, or toggling minor controls.

click.description: Crisp UI click — button press, toggle, selection. Short accent, sync exactly to the on-screen action.
click.recommended_use: Sync to primary button presses, menu opens, tab switches, or active control clicks.

ding.description: Crystal service/desk bell ding — pristine high-frequency chime with clean harmonic resonance.
ding.recommended_use: Use on tip reveals, "aha!" moments, notification alerts, or score/point additions.

error.description: Negative / error tone — failure state, a "wrong" beat, or a glitchy interruption.
error.recommended_use: Sync to error dialogues, validation failures, red crosses, or cautionary warnings.

glitch-1.description: Punchy digital glitch — hard-cut accent or sudden reveal. Trigger on the hit; let the decay bleed into the next shot (J-cut).
glitch-1.recommended_use: Use on rapid hard cuts, cyber/tech scene transitions, or disruptive data visualizations.

glitch-2.description: Harsh, longer glitch — chaotic / jarring transition or a distorted reveal.
glitch-2.recommended_use: Use when depicting system crashes, dramatic problem statements, or heavy glitch overlays.

glitch-3.description: Low-key glitch texture — subtle digital shift, minimal transition that sits under other audio.
glitch-3.recommended_use: Use under tech narration or as subtle texture behind code/terminal displays.

impact-bass-1.description: Bass impact hit — logo/hero snap, headline slam. Trigger on the visual landing; decay carries into the next shot (J-cut).
impact-bass-1.recommended_use: Place on major headline reveals, hero section slams, or powerful statement conclusions.

impact-bass-2.description: Bass impact with a short swell — brief anticipation then a deep hit. Place so the peak lands on the reveal.
impact-bass-2.recommended_use: Place so the swell leads into a major product reveal or metric punchline.

key-press.description: Single key press — one keystroke / terminal-input beat. Short accent, sync to the typed character.
key-press.recommended_use: Sync to single typed character, command prompt submission, or shortcut trigger.

mouse-click.description: Mechanical mouse click — sharp down-up tactile click for desktop UI interactions.
mouse-click.recommended_use: Sync directly to cursor pointer clicks on buttons, links, or navigation items.

notification.description: Notification chime — alert, message-in, toast/badge appears. Sync to the element entering.
notification.recommended_use: Sync to pop-up notifications, incoming messages, badge badges, or toast cards.

ping.description: Sharp electronic ping — punchy accent on a key reveal or data point. Sync to the beat.
ping.recommended_use: Trigger on charts drawing data points, bullet point highlights, or stat counters.

pop.description: Quick pop — element appear/spawn, chip/tag/badge in. Small precise accent, sync to the pop-in.
pop.recommended_use: Sync to cards scaling up, icons appearing, or stickers popping into view.

riser.description: Long cinematic riser (~10s build, peak at the end). Trigger at (climax_time - 10.03s) so it crests exactly on the reveal.
riser.recommended_use: Use before the climax or product grand reveal to build maximum anticipation.

sparkle.description: Bright sparkle / shimmer — magical reveal or "shine" highlight on a hero element. Sync to the highlight.
sparkle.recommended_use: Sync to gold badges, featured tier highlights, feature unlocks, or polished elements.

swoosh-fast.description: Ultra-fast dynamic swoosh (~0.28s) — sharp air-cut transition for quick flips, cards, and rapid scene cuts.
swoosh-fast.recommended_use: Sync to rapid frame cuts, swift card wipes, tab switches, and quick gesture sweeps.

typing.description: Typing burst (~1.5s of keys) — keyboard / code typing reveal, text-being-typed beat. Start as the text begins typing.
typing.recommended_use: Start as code blocks or terminal command lines begin streaming onto the screen.

whoosh-cinematic.description: Cinematic whoosh build (~5.5s) — sweeping scene transition. Align so the swell peaks on the cut.
whoosh-cinematic.recommended_use: Use on major section shifts or epic narrative transitions between acts.

whoosh-short.description: Short whoosh — quick swipe/slide accent, fast element move, snappy transition. Sync to the motion.
whoosh-short.recommended_use: Sync to horizontal sliding panels, modal entrances, or quick camera pans.

whoosh.description: Punchy whoosh/impact — fast reveal or hard transition accent. Sync to the motion.
whoosh.recommended_use: Standard transition sound for scene cuts, title wipes, and entrance animations.
